newsitem.title: MALTA: Congested Malta tries to lure motorists to buses.
newsitem.headline: Congested Malta tries to lure motorists to buses.

text.p: Malta on Wednesday launched a campaign to try to get more motorists to use buses and cut congestion on the Mediterranean island.

Transport Minister Joe Debono Grech told parliament on Tuesday that there were 232,000 registered vehicles, mostly private cars, for a population of 375,000. Car numbers have been increasing by some 10,000 a year.

"Traffic congestion is escalating at an alarming rate and the only intelligent alternative is to reduce the number of private cars on the road by promoting public transport," Victor Custo, chairman of the Public Transport Authority, told a news conference launching the campaign.
Commuters will be offered free rides and officials said they were working to increase or re-route buses, boost frequencies and introduce automatic ticketing.
